note: A pass other than the last that leaves at a position (SPEC 3.3.3, valid-walk rule 5). The spelling is right: a pass whose `from` is a position carries `to`. But a walk can continue only from a node, and this one stops part-way along ab and then claims to go on along cb. The diagnostic names the `to` key. A reader that checks only the spelling reads this chain clean.

diagnostics.message_advisory: only the last pass leaves at a position — the chain is dropped
